system_guides.D&D 5e: A class-based d20 fantasy game with a familiar mix of roleplay, exploration, and tactical combat. Characters grow steadily more capable as the story continues.
system_guides.AD&D 2e: An older-school fantasy game with distinct classes, detailed procedures, and more danger than modern D&D. Careful planning and creative problem-solving matter.
system_guides.D&D (edition not recorded): A fantasy adventure using a version of Dungeons & Dragons that was not preserved in the public archive. Expect character roles, d20 checks, exploration, and combat.
system_guides.Kids on Bikes: A rules-light, story-first game about ordinary people facing strange mysteries. Relationships, shared worldbuilding, and risky choices matter more than tactical combat.
system_guides.Kids on Brooms: A rules-light game of magical school life, friendships, rivalries, and mysteries. Players help shape the school and story together, with flexible dice mechanics rather than tactical combat.
system_guides.Traveller: A skill-based 2d6 science-fiction game built for open-ended travel, trade, exploration, and survival. Choices and consequences drive the story more than character levels.
system_guides.Deadlands: The Weird West: Fast-moving western adventure mixed with horror, magic, and alternate history. Cards, poker-inspired mechanics, and cinematic action give the system its distinctive feel.
system_guides.Final Fantasy 5e: A fantasy adventure built on D&D 5e with Final Fantasy-inspired heroes, magic, monsters, and tone. Expect recognizable d20 play with video-game-inspired flavor.
system_guides.Cyberpunk (edition not recorded): A high-tech, low-life game where skills, equipment, reputation, and hard choices matter. The exact Cyberpunk edition was not preserved in the public archive.
system_guides.Twilight: 2000: A grounded survival game focused on scarce resources, travel, difficult decisions, and dangerous tactical encounters in a world destabilized by war.
system_guides.Good Society: A collaborative social roleplaying game inspired by Regency drama. Relationships, reputation, letters, rumors, and personal desires take the place of traditional combat.
system_guides.Star Trek (edition not recorded): A science-fiction adventure centered on a starship crew solving problems through cooperation, expertise, diplomacy, and exploration. The exact edition was not preserved.
system_guides.Shadowdark: A fast, dangerous fantasy dungeon-crawling game with simple rules, old-school pressure, and limited resources. Clever decisions are often safer than a fair fight.
system_guides.Fallout 2d20: A post-apocalyptic 2d20 game about exploration, scavenging, survival, and action in the Fallout universe. Players build dice pools and spend resources to improve important rolls.
system_guides.Ten Candles: A rules-light tragic horror game designed for a single intense session. The characters will not survive, so play focuses on hope, fear, sacrifice, and the story of their final hours.
system_guides.Call of Cthulhu 7e: A percentile-based mystery and horror game about ordinary people investigating truths that can threaten their safety and sanity. Clues and difficult choices matter more than winning fights.
system_guides.System not publicly recorded: The surviving archive identifies the adventure but not its rules system. The public listing stays intentionally general rather than guessing.
